readerEvidence.summary: All36 prepared pages personally visually read in solutions50. Bulgarian D1-D3 retained under original IDs with native parts; full matching English official solutions/rubrics recovered and arranged in native numbered solution sections. Existing English transcription reused only after direct comparison with all20 original key pages. Full Bulgarian instructions/constants restored. No independent model checker.
sourceGaps: Referenced blank Summary Answersheets and Cover sheet are absent from the full archived2016 inventory. All supplied official solutions and worked diagrams are recovered.
sourceDiscrepancies: BG D1 defines TJD since JD2440000.5; both English question copies and key define tMJD since MJD2440000. Source conventions retained without correction.
The English key eclipse montage prints12:45 at right; BG and both English question-only editions print00:45.
Official key D1.5 prints96260s =1.12570d; D3.2 states22.0d then uses22.2 in ratios. D2.6 repeats an equals sign. These printed inconsistencies are retained.
The key graph D1.7 writes intercept -0.008 day, while its worked calculation uses -0.010 day; both source readings retained.
